experiment: G2 gating statistic prior v2: s = E_halo - E_bg (SGHL v2)
s_definition: s = mean(seg_sigmoid[halo]) - E_bg(class); halo = dilate(gt,5)-gt; E_bg = 该类全部正常测试图 seg 输出全局均值 (在线估计, 零标注); s 不需要 interior
gate_convention: g = sigmoid(-(s-tau)/T); s 低 -> HS 全开 (合成), s 高 -> HS 退火 (真实)

suggested_init.note: T = pooled synth s 的 std/2, 使 sigmoid 过渡带 (~±2T) 覆盖 synth 上尾到 real 下尾
